world.title: ‘Don't turn outer space into warzone’: China slams US deployment of weapons in space
world.summary: China criticized the United States for its deployment of weapons in space, calling for an end to the military build-up in this area. The Chinese government expressed concerns about the potential for outer space to become a warzone and urged Washington to reconsider its actions. This statement reflects ongoing tensions between the two nations regarding space security and military activities.

world.title: China urges U.S. to ‘stop preparing for war in outer space’
world.summary: China has urged the United States to cease its military expansion in outer space, warning against the weaponization of this domain. This statement follows the U.S. Space Force's confirmation of deploying weapons into orbit for the first time. The call reflects ongoing tensions between Beijing and Washington, two major geopolitical rivals with competing interests in space.

world.title: Jinnah in, Mujibur Rahman out at Dhaka University museum; Pak founder's portrait shredded
world.summary: Sheikh Mujibur Rahman's photographs were replaced by those of Muhammad Ali Jinnah at Dhaka University's DUCSU Museum, leading to student protests. The removal of Jinnah's portraits was initiated by students, and the university has launched an investigation into the circumstances surrounding the controversial display. The incident has sparked significant debate regarding historical representation and national identity.

business.title: New Italian unicorn Exein rides the physical AI wave
business.summary: Italian startup Exein has achieved unicorn status after raising $270 million in a funding round led by Headline, reaching a valuation of $1.7 billion. The company aims to enhance cybersecurity for physical AI, evolving from its original focus on Internet of Things (IoT) solutions. This funding marks a significant milestone for the European tech landscape.

business.title: After 'AI will kill us all warnings', Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei may have just 'blamed' Mark Zuckerberg and Jensen Huang for lying about …
business.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei criticized tech industry leaders, including Mark Zuckerberg and Jensen Huang, following the resignation of a former employee who warned about the potential dangers of AI. Amodei's comments reflect concerns over corporate responsibility and transparency in AI development. He emphasized the need for honest discussions about AI's risks and the implications of unchecked technological advancement.

business.title: CAS crash: Nifty plunges 462 points in less than 30 seconds. Will Sebi’s review break trend?
business.summary: Nifty experienced a rapid 2% decline, dropping 462 points in under 30 seconds during Tuesday's closing auction session, before recovering. This volatility raised concerns regarding the new CAS system. In response, Sebi is considering changes to expiry-day settlement and trading mechanisms to address these fluctuations. The market's instability highlights ongoing issues within the current trading framework.

technology.title: iPhone 18 Pro Max Delivery Delay
technology.summary: Customers in India and the US who missed the initial pre-orders for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max may face delivery delays until late September or October. Apple introduced these models during its recent ‘Surprise and Shine’ event. The delays could impact those eager to receive the latest devices from the tech giant.

technology.title: Redmi Note 17 Pro, Note 17 Pro Max launched in India with up to 10,000mAh battery: Price, specs
technology.summary: Xiaomi has launched the Redmi Note 17 Pro and Note 17 Pro Max in India on September 15. The Pro Max features a 10,000mAh silicon-carbon battery, while the Pro has a 9,000mAh battery. Both models expand Xiaomi's Note series, offering enhanced specifications. Pricing details and additional features were also announced during the launch event.

technology.title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE Arrives in India With Exynos 2500 and 120Hz Display: Price, Offers
technology.summary: Samsung has launched the Galaxy S26 FE in India, featuring the Exynos 2500 chipset and a 6.7-inch Dynamic AMOLED 2X display with a 120Hz refresh rate. The smartphone includes a 50MP camera with 3x optical zoom and runs on One UI 9 based on Android 17. Pricing and offers for the device have also been announced.

sports.title: IND vs AFG 2nd T20I 2026 results, highlights and scorecard as Sanju Samson's 57 makes it an easy win for India
sports.summary: In the second T20I match between India and Afghanistan at Arun Jaitley Stadium, India secured an easy victory, largely due to Sanju Samson's impressive 57 runs. The match showcased India's strong performance, leading to a favorable outcome. Highlights and detailed scorecard information are available for fans and analysts looking to review the key moments from the game.

sports.title: Nigar Sultana set to step down as Bangladesh T20I captain
sports.summary: Nigar Sultana will step down as Bangladesh's T20I captain after the Asian Games. The 29-year-old has communicated her decision to the board, aiming to concentrate on her batting and wicketkeeping skills. Despite stepping away from the T20I captaincy, she intends to continue leading the team in One Day Internationals (ODIs) moving forward.

sports.title: 'Why no one understands his position': Ashwin has one big question about Sanju Samson’s India future
sports.summary: Sanju Samson's international cricket career has been marked by notable talent and impressive performances, yet he faces ongoing uncertainty regarding his position in the Indian team. Despite showcasing his abilities on significant platforms, questions remain about his future with the national squad. Ashwin has raised concerns about the lack of clarity surrounding Samson's role and prospects within the team.

health.title: New study explores why the brain mixes up memories
health.summary: A recent study published in Cerebral Cortex examines why older adults often confuse memories. Researchers conducted brain scans revealing that shifting neural firing patterns in the hippocampus contribute to this phenomenon. The findings indicate that while memories may become less precise with age, they are not entirely forgotten, providing insight into the relationship between aging and memory recall difficulties.

health.title: Researchers tested 30 nanometre magnetic particles on 94 blood samples; they detected amoxicillin allergy with 98 percent sensitivity, versus about 17 percent for a standard commercial test
health.summary: Researchers developed a blood testing platform using 30 nanometre magnetic particles to detect amoxicillin allergies. In tests involving 94 blood samples, the new method achieved 98 percent sensitivity, significantly outperforming standard commercial tests, which only had about 17 percent sensitivity. This advancement could improve the identification of individuals who are genuinely allergic to amoxicillin, a widely used antibiotic.

health.title: New brain atlas can aid fight against Alzheimer’s disease
health.summary: Researchers have developed a new brain atlas that identifies 1,067 microproteins in the human frontal cortex, analyzing samples from individuals with and without Alzheimer’s disease. This study suggests that these microproteins, previously considered genetic clutter, may play a crucial role in understanding and potentially combating Alzheimer’s-related brain decay, particularly through their connection to immune cell dysfunction.

science.title: Future cities on the Moon will run out of water faster than you think. Here's why
science.summary: The Moon's permanently shadowed craters contain water ice, raising concerns about the sustainability of future lunar settlements. While plans for bases, villages, and cities are ambitious, estimates suggest that the available water supply may be limited. This poses significant challenges for long-term habitation and industry on the Moon, necessitating careful consideration of resource management and sustainability.

science.title: Bay Area scientists investigate possible dark matter signal deep underground
science.summary: Bay Area scientists are investigating a potential dark matter signal detected at the Sanford Underground Research Facility in South Dakota. A single unknown particle, isolated from light and cosmic rays, collided with a xenon atom's nucleus, resulting in the ejection of electrons. This unexpected event may provide insights into the elusive nature of dark matter in physics.

science.title: HDSR Star Party draws astronomy enthusiasts from across India
science.summary: The fourth edition of the Hanle Dark Sky Reserve (HDSR) Star Party took place from September 7 to 12 at the Indian Astronomical Observatory in Hanle, Ladakh. Approximately 40 amateur astronomers and expert astrophotographers from various states, including Chandigarh, Goa, Gujarat, Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, Karnataka, and Maharashtra, participated in the event, celebrating astronomy and stargazing.

entertainment.title: Manoj Muntashir gets trolled for sharing 'Adipurush' song after 'Jai Jai Ram' release from Ranbir Kapoor's 'Ramayana': 'Isko khushi doosre ki bardhast nai hoti'
entertainment.summary: Manoj Muntashir faced online criticism after sharing a song from 'Adipurush' following the release of 'Jai Jai Ram', the first song from Nitesh Tiwari’s 'Ramayana'. The timing of his post drew negative reactions from netizens, who expressed their discontent, suggesting that he could not tolerate others' happiness. The contrasting releases have led to discussions among fans and critics alike.

entertainment.title: Nani Caught Between Two Sides Of Paradise!
entertainment.summary: Natural Star Nani and Kayadu Lohar star in the upcoming film "The Paradise," directed by Srikanth Odela. The movie is set to release on the 24th, with paid premieres scheduled for the 23rd. As the release date approaches, the team is navigating various promotional activities and expectations surrounding the film, aiming for a successful launch.

entertainment.title: Shah Rukh Khan breaks silence on Ranveer Singh's 'Dhurandhar', says he loved both the parts: 'Fantastic'
entertainment.summary: Shah Rukh Khan has expressed his admiration for the 'Dhurandhar' franchise, stating he loved both parts and found them "fantastic." His comments come as the franchise continues to gain popularity in Bollywood. The success of both installments has generated significant interest among fans, who are eager to hear more from prominent figures in the industry regarding the films.
